The ONLY trainable component is the standalone SmallUNet denoiser (params_M 0.2329) pretrained FBP->truth that NEVER sees the DC steps. The fixed UNTRAINED DC operator drags the recon below the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor regardless of denoiser quality. (3) ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3 -> 1 (fewer FIXED-DC steps). Rationale: itnets OWN documented champion insight is k=1 wins on noisy LDCT (fewer DC steps); since the DC operator here is UNTRAINED and floor-pulling, k=1 passes the well-trained denoiser output through the LEAST harmful fixed-DC correction. This is the clean diagnostic of whether the fixed-DC STEP-COUNT (vs the trainable-param absence) is the floor-puller. Reverts to the iter-4 BEST config (train_n=200) NOT the iter-5 regressed data-trade. pretrain_epochs 220->200 is the budget backstop (NOT a 2nd hypothesis-knob) to hold the HARD 20-min wall conservatively. All else identical to iter-4 (itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: k=3->1 keeps the recon closer to the well-trained denoiser, SSIM rises modestly above 0.7022 (predict ~0.72-0.78) but hr STAYS 0.000 -- a single fixed-DC step still cannot credit above the ~0.81 floor (denoiser is FBP->truth, FBP-information-capped; the untrained DC adds no params). FALSIFIER (operative): if hr > 0 at k=1, the fixed-DC STEP-COUNT was the floor-puller and itnet_k is the live lever toward 20 (implausible given zero DC params, but the clean discriminator). PREDICTED iter-6 hr = 0.000, SSIM ~0.74. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): pretrain epochs cost is UNCHANGED by k (DC steps run only at eval, not in pretrain_denoiser); k=3->1 makes the 214-slice val pass CHEAPER (1 DC step/slice vs 3). iter-4 fit: per_epoch(200)=4.21s, fixed=185s. ep200 at train_n=200 -> pred = 185 + 200*4.21 = 1027s = 17.1 min, inside 1200s with ~170s margin (sized DELIBERATELY conservative: doc warns the v2 sibling overran at 1237s; real wall will be BELOW 1027s since val DC is now cheaper; the 30-min sbatch wall is the only hard fence). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; NO fov= override). (6) Loop continues -- no control returned.
